stages.title: Stage 1 — Story first
stages.text: Play the five chapters and pick up every optional mission and stranger strand as it appears. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1 (the one possibly missable moment). Start all eight Strangers & Freaks strands when they are offered — the five stranger finals can go quiet for whole chapters. Everything story-related unlocks in one playthrough; there is no mission replay and no online trophy.

stages.title: Stage 2 — The 100% ledger
stages.text: After the story, free-roam through the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats): every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs and 8 bank vaults. Most trophies in this stage fall out of the checklist itself.

stages.title: Stage 3 — Strangers & cleanup
stages.text: Finish the eight Strangers & Freaks strands and their finals, sweep up the remaining activities and collectibles, and chase the five trophies whose unlock method is still unconfirmed. The platinum lands here.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this platinum unlocks automatically. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% ledger, then strangers and cleanup — and use the tracker here to see what is left.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies. This one unlocks automatically the moment the 54th lands.
Plan for roughly 200 hours across the three stages, in one playthrough — there is no mission replay, so the Chapter 1 meditation and the stranger strands must be done while they are available.
Do not use cheats: they disable trophies and saving.

claims.t: Platinum; official description “Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.”
Worth 300 PSN points; the full list totals 1,350 points (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze) and 1,000 Gamerscore.
The hardest trophy in the list, because it requires 100% completion and all eight stranger strands.
One playthrough is enough; there are no online trophies.
Cheats disable trophies and saving.
Platinum time is disputed: KeenGamer estimates about 200 hours, Push Square says up to 300 hours or more.
Difficulty 4/10; 15 manual save slots; no mission replay and no New Game Plus; cheats disable trophies and saving while active.

dispute.q: How long does the platinum really take?
dispute.a: About 200 hours of play, says KeenGamer.
dispute.b: Up to 300 hours or more, says Push Square.
dispute.call: Plan on 200 hours of focused play; 300 hours is the slower completionist pace that counts every detour. Both guides agree on the work — only the pace differs.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Open Progress > Stats and work the checklist numbers, not everything in the game: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos, 42 of 42 shooting-range golds, 42 of 42 drone trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 15 Bret target decks, plus the robbery and fencing totals. Skip an activity once its number is met — and do not trust the in-game percentage alone, it under-reads.

steps.t: Open Progress > Stats and work the checklist. It takes roughly 100 hours after the story — the longest single grind on the list.

The checklist needs: every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest; 70 of 80 challenges; 15 of 18 card sets; 100 WAiNK locations; 33 underwater discoveries; 100 Cocaine Flamingos; 39 gang operations; 22 bank jobs; 7 payday loan jobs; 8 bank vaults.
Do not trust the in-game percentage alone — it reads closer to 60% when the true completion is near done, so track the checklist items themselves.
Vehicles: 200 of 277 base models for the checklist (the trophy Whip It Good needs only 100). Animals: study 100 of 255 with binoculars.
Stunts: 300 for 100% (the Cunning Stunts trophy needs only 250). Challenges: 70 of 80 (the One Last Thing trophy needs only 50). Card sets: 15 of 18 (Don't Touch My Deck needs only 3).

claims.t: Gold; official description “Attain 100% Completion.”

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges are in-game achievements listed under Progress > Challenges; 70 of 80 are needed for 100% completion, so keep going past 50 if you want the platinum.

steps.t: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. They cover combat, driving, exploration and activities.
The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 — this trophy pops on the way.
Check Progress > Challenges to see which ones are closest to done.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Complete 50 Challenges.”
80 challenges exist in total.
100% completion needs 70 of 80 challenges.
There are 80 challenges; 50 unlock this trophy and 70 are needed for 100% completion.
View all challenges and their requirements under Progress > Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a four-star wanted level with your partner, then lose the cops and escape. Commit crimes together until four stars show, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears.

steps.t: Bring your partner along (hold right on the D-pad and press triangle to call them), then raise a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat radius and stay out of sight until the wanted level clears. A fast motorcycle through traffic, then a vehicle swap to become unrecognisable, works well.
Do it while doing robberies — a 4-star level comes free with bank vaults and jewelry stores.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.”
Your partner is called by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle.
Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.
Swapping vehicles after escaping makes you unrecognisable to the police.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back to back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit the first shop, keep the heat, and move straight to the next two before the wanted level clears.

steps.t: Bring your partner, then rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

Loot a couple of items in each store and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. If the trophy does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
If you leave the first store before the police arrive, you may need a fourth shop to keep the chain alive.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.”
The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
The trophy unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
Breaking the safe in the back room needs sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or scanning it with WAiNK, so this builds naturally through the story; check Progress > Vehicles to see what you have found.

steps.t: Open the WAiNK app from the phone (hold up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive it.
Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. New unique vehicles go into the database.
The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). The checklist needs 200 of the base models, so keep scanning past 100.
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles, scrolling over each category.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Discover 100 vehicles.”
557 vehicles at launch: cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes.
Scanning with WAiNK is enough; driving the vehicle is not required.
The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models.
Discovered vehicles are tracked under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
You discover a vehicle by getting inside it or scanning it with WAiNK.
Track discovered vehicles under Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single activation of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five kills before it ends.

steps.t: Activate Combat Focus with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm. It slows time and highlights vulnerable spots, draining the purple focus bar.
Buff your focus first: eat and drink, wash your face or shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press triangle) to stretch the focus window.

Line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them fast without missing. Wear body armour (from Ammu-Nation) so you can step out of cover, and use a full-auto assault rifle like the Duke 556.
It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — use gang criminals.
Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. By the time you have done the other trophies you will likely be at level 4 and may earn this naturally.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.”
Combat Focus is L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time, highlights weak spots and drains the purple focus bar.
Adrenaline extends Combat Focus; it is used by holding L1 and pressing triangle.
Focus has 4 levels, checked under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus.
The trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA — planes on the open airfield do not count. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, board via the stairs by the boarding bridge, get to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and fly at least 1 km away.

steps.t: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — the planes on the open airfield do not count; it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge.

The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it; next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane. You can also walk in through the terminal.
Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The unlock is delayed until you are that far.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.”
Hidden on PSN.
Only a plane docked to a departure terminal counts — airfield planes do not.
The easiest plane is at terminals E3/E4.
The trophy pops once you are 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map; enter through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, then shoot enemies until it pops.

steps.t: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the air base.
Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Kinda hot in these Rhinos.”
Hidden on PSN.
The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the base.
Entry is through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun, then break in through the back door with it — kicking the door triggers the alarm. Find the safe code on the note in the back room and loot the safe.

steps.t: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. It unlocks the Snap Gun, for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies on the map with a green icon in unfogged areas.
Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently. Kicking the door triggers the alarm and fails the stealth.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Rob a jewelry store without being detected.”
Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) unlocks the Snap Gun and the jewelry store robberies.
The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently; no equip needed.
Kicking the door triggers the alarm; the Snap Gun is the stealth approach.
The safe code is on a note in the back room.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape. The eight large bank vaults open up during Chapter 4 with the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — all eight are needed for 100% completion, but five are enough for this trophy.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe). It is marked automatically from story progress and teaches the vault robbery: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash in, and the vault opens.
Go in while the vault is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone — bring your partner and hold right on the D-pad to hand off one bag.
After that mission, pay Yasmani (the Chapter 3 fence) for security-van tips — $10,000 a tip, after his earlier quests (robbing 2 Payday Loans). Tipped vans are marked purple; follow them to the bank.
Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level. Escape on a fast motorcycle through traffic, then swap vehicles to become unrecognisable.
There are 8 large bank jobs in total; this trophy needs any 5, but 100% needs all 8 — and a single vault pays up to $205,000, the best money in the endgame.

claims.t: Silver; official description “Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.”
The vault introduction is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
A partner is needed to carry the cash — hold right on the D-pad to hand off a bag.
Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000 after his earlier quests.
Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level.
8 large bank jobs exist; 100% needs all 8; one vault pays up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open and lose the cops — or tail one to a bank vault during the Chapter 4 mission, which counts the same way.

steps.t: The easiest way: do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, because you tail the truck to the bank.
Tail the armored truck to the bank, enter the vault while it is open, steal the cash and escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray.

Earlier method: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks. Block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
All 8 large bank jobs are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Rob an Armored Truck and escape.”
Robbing a large bank's vault in the Chapter 4 mission counts as robbing an armored truck.
Armored trucks can also be stopped on the street: block the path, sticky-bomb the back door, escape the heat radius.
Sticky bombs are found in the back of Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
100% completion needs all 8 large bank jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, fly and sail into every region until the map is fully revealed — flying a plane over fogged areas is the fastest way.

steps.t: Fully unfog the whole map — every black-fogged area must be revealed.
The fastest way is by plane: fly over every fogged area until the entire map is visible.
Leonida has 52 areas in total.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Explore all of Leonida.”
The whole map must be unfogged.
Flying a plane over fogged areas is the fastest way to unfog.
Leonida has 52 areas.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Gang operations are marked on the map; hit one per gang. All 39 operations are needed for 100% completion, so this pops on the way.

steps.t: Complete one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total.
Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress.
Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed, bottom right.
100% needs all 39 operations, so this trophy pops on the way.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.”
9 gangs, 39 illegal operations in total.
Operations show as yellow map icons near them; many are marked automatically by story progress.
Per-gang progress is under Progress > Gangs.
100% completion needs all 39 operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to an ocean-view bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and watch the view; the exact trigger is still being confirmed, so try the rooftop bar first.

steps.t: The unlock method is not confirmed yet. The description says: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
Best current guess, from the description alone: order a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach and drink it while looking at the view. Try the beachfront bars in free-roam.
If it does not pop, try different beachfront venues and different times of day, and check back — this page will be updated when a guide source confirms it.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.”
Hidden on PSN.

trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a showroom and crash out through the glass — the exact method is still unconfirmed, so if one showroom does not trigger it, try another.

steps.t: The unlock method is not confirmed yet. The description says: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

If it does not pop, try different showrooms and different vehicles, and check back — this page will be updated when a guide source confirms it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal the three key valuables at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and escape. Grab all three items inside the alley, then get out before security stops you.

steps.t: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Before going, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to destroy the safe.

Inside the bowling alley, pick up the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office (gold icon), the unique shotgun variant “Gutterball Moreland 850” on the table in the north-east corner (gold icon), and the safe in the north-east hallway office — blow it up with sticky bombs.
The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. Killing the enemies is not necessary.

It is not missable: if you do not get all 3 items during the optional mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go back for the remaining valuables. You do not need all 3 in one go.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.”
Hidden on PSN.
Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train strength for each character — gyms, melee and heavy lifting raise it — until both bars are full.

steps.t: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, selecting a character and scrolling to Strength (heart icon).
You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when character switching opens.

Work out at a fitness club — buy a membership, and always go together with both characters (hold right on the D-pad and press triangle to call your partner). While one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress.
Filter the map by Activities (dumbbell icon) to find fitness clubs all over Vice City. You can also work out at home after the story.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “A partnership with mass appeal.”
Hidden on PSN.
Needs maximum strength on both characters at the same time.
Strength is checked under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
Character switching opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
Working out together trains both characters at once — double progress.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Robberies, crimes, stunts and illegal work all feed the profile; play the game broadly and the total climbs on its own.

steps.t: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see how many of 500 you have done.

Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On). Whenever an action affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right side of the screen.

Profiles, from cleanest to worst: Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence), Hardened (incapacitating without killing, e.g. limb shots), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones), Irredeemable (a permanent status after excessive violence).

It happens passively while working on the other trophies — every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is still missing at the end, it can be farmed quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car, but note that cops shoot on sight more often at Psycho or Irredeemable.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Choices made (for better or worse).”
Hidden on PSN.
Needs 500 actions that affect the criminal profile; progress is shown by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Criminal Profile notifications are under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications.
Five profile tiers: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable (permanent).
It accrues passively during robberies and enemy encounters.

trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. The precise method is still being confirmed by the guide sources; the steps below are the best reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills as you earn them from robberies; the same $250,000 also counts toward 100% completion.

steps.t: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew). It unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you launder marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Deliver $250,000 in total. It counts across all robberies; you do not need $250,000 at once.
It comes naturally while doing the robberies for 100%. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.”
The Dye Pack Jammer unlocks from Chapter 3's Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew).
Yasmani in Vice City pays the most for marked bills.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear — anything in any shop counts, and you can find shops on the map via Touch Pad > Style.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 in total across all types of shops. The total counts across every shop — it does not need to be in one place.

The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items. Shop counts: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Spend $100,000 across all shops.”

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties from the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, 7th Avenue Garage $12,000, Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000, Persistence Road Garage $7,600, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Bonita Court Garage $34,000, Atlantic Court Garage $40,000 and Store n' Bolt $16,800 — $160,000 in total. Each garage adds one parking spot for registered vehicles.

steps.t: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. There are also 4 story-related garages, but this trophy only needs the 8 purchasable ones.
Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). You get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, is installed on your phone.
Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. Total cost: $160,000.
Robberies are the quick way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Purchase all garage properties.”
8 purchasable garages (plus 4 story-related ones that do not count).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Register a vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop — the fee varies with the vehicle's value, so use cheap cars and bikes. Scooter Bros then delivers your registered, fully repaired vehicles to you for a small fee; buy more garages if you run out of parking spots.

steps.t: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location.
Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds one or more parking spots, and you need spots to register vehicles.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click “Respray” and “Register”. Moses is unlocked by the same mission that unlocks the app.
At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers. Later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, and register them at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Registering costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.

claims.t: Bronze; official description “Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.”
The Scooter Bros app arrives after Chapter 2's Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
Garages add parking spots — register capacity depends on them (see Little Boxes).
Registration is done at Moses in Port Gellhorn via “Respray” and “Register”.
At first only tracker-free vehicles; from Chapter 3, Standard Tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
